records.source: Really? That's surprising.$8#$b#I've lived in the valley my whole life, but I've never really done anything memorable. I want to go on an adventure!$8
records.translation: Talaga? Nakagugulat iyon.$8#$b#Buong buhay akong nanirahan sa lambak, pero wala pa talaga akong nagawang di-malilimutan. Gusto kong makipagsapalaran!$8

records.source: I see...$8
records.translation: Nauunawaan ko...$8

records.source: Yea... I guess you would be one to appreciate this somber ambience.
records.translation: Oo... Siguro ay isa ka ngang taong nagpapahalaga sa mapanglaw na kapaligirang ito.

records.source: ...That's true.$8
records.translation: ...Totoo iyan.$8

records.source: Yeah... I guess my own life is okay...$s
records.translation: Oo... Siguro ay maayos naman ang buhay ko...$s

records.preserveReason: The value contains only punctuation, emotion controls, and/or the player-name token, with no translatable wording.

records.source: I would feel better if I could believe that...#$b#But I don't.$s
records.translation: Gagaan ang pakiramdam ko kung mapaniniwalaan ko iyon...#$b#Pero hindi.$s

records.preserveReason: The value contains only punctuation, emotion controls, and/or the player-name token, with no translatable wording.

records.source: @... I'm alright.$8
records.translation: @... Ayos lang ako.$8

records.source: ...okay.$8
records.translation: ...sige.$8

records.source: I guess when you have something to lose, it's normal to be afraid...$l
records.translation: Siguro ay normal lang matakot kapag may maaari kang mawala...$l

records.source: ...Um, okay. Sorry.$9
records.translation: ...Um, sige. Paumanhin.$9

records.source: Summer's here. It's not really my favorite season.#$e#The air is so muggy I feel like I'm floating in soup.
records.translation: Narito na ang tag-init. Hindi ko talaga ito paboritong panahon.#$e#Napakamaalinsangan ng hangin, para akong lumulutang sa sopas.

records.source: My pet guinea pig, David, just hates this hot weather. He's fussy.
records.translation: Talagang kinamumuhian ng alaga kong dagang-gini na si David ang mainit na panahong ito. Napakaarte niya.

records.source: The air is so thick with honey and nectar all summer. I almost feel dizzy.$u
records.translation: Punô ng pulot at nektar ang hangin sa buong tag-init. Halos nahihilo ako.$u

records.source: Have you decorated your house at all? That's what I'd be doing if I had a house.
records.translation: Nalagyan mo na ba ng palamuti ang bahay mo? Iyon ang gagawin ko kung may bahay ako.

records.source: I went to the beach last night, after dark... Sometimes you can see strange lights bobbing over the sea.#$e#Or maybe that was just a dream I had... It doesn't feel real anymore.
records.translation: Pumunta ako sa dalampasigan kagabi matapos dumilim... Minsan ay makakakita ka ng mga kakaibang liwanag na lumulutang sa ibabaw ng dagat.#$e#O baka panaginip ko lang iyon... Parang hindi na iyon totoo.

records.source: If I knew how to use a sword I would be exploring those caves by the mountain lake right now. It's probably nice and cool in there.
records.translation: Kung marunong akong gumamit ng espada, ginagalugad ko na sana ngayon ang mga yungib sa tabi ng lawa sa bundok. Malamang ay maganda at malamig doon.

records.source: Ew, I hope I don't get a tan this summer.$s
records.translation: Kadiri, sana ay hindi kumayumanggi ang balat ko ngayong tag-init.$s

records.source: I kind of wish I had a cat. Unfortunately, my Dad is allergic to pretty much everything.
records.translation: Parang gusto kong magkaroon ng pusa. Sa kasamaang-palad, may alerhiya si Tatay sa halos lahat ng bagay.

records.source: I'm looking forward to fall... the cool mountain breeze, the swirling red petals, the smell of mushrooms... *sigh*
records.translation: Inaasam ko ang taglagas... ang malamig na simoy ng bundok, ang umiikot na mga pulang talulot, ang amoy ng mga kabute... *buntong-hininga*

records.source: Do you ever get an urge to go exploring, @?#$q 25/26 summer_Sun_old#Okay... pretend you just won a free vacation. Where would you go?#$r 25 0 Sun_25#The beach#$r 26 30 Sun_26#In a dark cave#$r 26 30 Sun_26#The old, gnarled forest#$r 25 0 Sun_25#Joja Mega-Mall
records.translation: Nakadarama ka ba kung minsan ng pagnanais na maggalugad, @?#$q 25/26 summer_Sun_old#Sige... magkunwari kang nanalo ka ng libreng bakasyon. Saan ka pupunta?#$r 25 0 Sun_25#Sa dalampasigan#$r 26 30 Sun_26#Sa isang madilim na yungib#$r 26 30 Sun_26#Sa matanda at baluktot na kagubatan#$r 25 0 Sun_25#Joja Mega-Mall

records.source: $p 25#I do... but you probably wouldn't like the places I'm thinking about...|Maybe we'll be neighbors someday. I think we both have similar, weird tastes.$h
records.translation: $p 25#Oo... pero malamang ay hindi mo magugustuhan ang mga lugar na iniisip ko...|Baka maging magkapitbahay tayo balang araw. Sa tingin ko'y pareho tayong may kakaibang hilig.$h

records.source: Huh. I think that would get old fast.
records.translation: Ha. Sa tingin ko'y mabilis iyong makasasawa.

records.source: Yea! That sounds wonderful.$h
records.translation: Oo! Mukhang kahanga-hanga iyon.$h

records.source: I would love to live in an old farmhouse like you.#$b#The creak of a floorboard, the slow plumes of dust whispering through the rafters... There's something special about an old building, isn't there?
records.translation: Gustung-gusto kong manirahan sa isang lumang Bahay-Bukid na tulad ng sa iyo.#$b#Ang langitngit ng tabla sa sahig, ang mababagal na ulap ng alikabok na bumubulong sa mga tahilan... May natatangi sa isang lumang gusali, hindi ba?

records.source: You're an interesting ${guy^lady}$, @. I'm glad you moved here.$h
records.translation: Kawili-wili kang ${lalaki^babae}$, @. Natutuwa akong lumipat ka rito.$h

records.source: I'm actually enjoying myself this summer.$h#$e#It's funny how quickly one's outlook can change.
records.translation: Talagang nasisiyahan ako ngayong tag-init.$h#$e#Nakakatawa kung gaano kabilis magbago ang pananaw ng isang tao.

records.source: I used to think Pelican Town was kinda drab, but lately I'm starting to love some things about it.$h
records.translation: Dati ay akala ko medyo mapanglaw ang Bayan ng Pelican, pero nitong huli ay nagsisimula nang magustuhan ko ang ilang bagay dito.$h

records.source: Wow, you look nice today.#$e#I mean, that summer air is really good for the complexion, isn't it?... heh...$l
records.translation: Wow, ang ganda ng hitsura mo ngayon.#$e#Ibig kong sabihin, talagang mabuti sa kutis ang hangin ng tag-init, hindi ba?... heh...$l

records.source: Do you ever get lonely on your farm?
records.translation: Nalulungkot ka ba kung minsan sa bukid mo?

records.source: Ah... Fall's here!$h#$e#I was getting so tired of summer.
records.translation: Ah... Narito na ang taglagas!$h#$e#Sawang-sawa na ako sa tag-init.

records.source: I need to stretch my legs and get some fresh air today.
records.translation: Kailangan kong iunat ang mga binti ko at lumanghap ng sariwang hangin ngayon.

records.source: $d joja#I try to help out in the shop on most days. Business has been pretty bad since the Joja Mart opened, though.|Ever since Joja Mart shut down we've been doing great at the shop!$h
records.translation: $d joja#Sinisikap kong tumulong sa tindahan halos araw-araw. Pero humina nang husto ang negosyo mula nang magbukas ang JojaMart.|Mula nang magsara ang JojaMart ay napakaganda ng takbo ng tindahan namin!$h

records.source: I can't wait to see some pumpkins this year.$h#$e#The spirit's eve festival happens at the end of the season. It's pretty low-key compared to what you'd see in Zuzu City, but for a small town like this it's a lot of fun.
records.translation: Sabik akong makakita ng ilang kalabasa ngayong taon.$h#$e#Nagaganap ang Bisperas ng mga Espiritu sa pagtatapos ng panahon. Hindi iyon engrande kumpara sa makikita mo sa Lungsod ng Zuzu, pero napakasaya nito para sa ganitong kaliit na bayan.

records.source: #$1 AbigailHAND#Last night I dreamt that my left hand had turned into a gigantic %noun. Does that mean anything?#$e#%Abigail doesn't seem to be interested in talking right now.
records.translation: #$1 AbigailHAND#Kagabi ay napanaginipan kong naging isang napakalaking %noun ang kaliwang kamay ko. May ibig sabihin kaya iyon?#$e#%Mukhang hindi interesado si Abigail na makipag-usap ngayon.

records.source: $d cc#I can't believe you fixed up that old Community Center all by yourself. I'm really impressed.|Do you have any scarecrows on your farm?
records.translation: $d cc#Hindi ako makapaniwalang inayos mo nang mag-isa ang lumang Sentro ng Komunidad. Talagang humanga ako.|May mga panakot-uwak ba sa bukid mo?

records.source: Hmm... what should I do tonight?#$q 27/28 fall_Sun_old#I was thinking about dyeing my hair again... what do you think?#$r 27 10 Sun_27#Dye it black.#$r 27 10 Sun_27#Why not blonde?#$r 27 20 Sun_WildColor#How about bubblegum pink?#$r 28 0 Sun_28#I like your hair just the way it is!
records.translation: Hmm... ano ang dapat kong gawin ngayong gabi?#$q 27/28 fall_Sun_old#Iniisip kong kulayan ulit ang buhok ko... ano sa tingin mo?#$r 27 10 Sun_27#Kulayan iyon ng itim.#$r 27 10 Sun_27#Bakit hindi kulay-blonde?#$r 27 20 Sun_WildColor#Paano kung rosas na bubblegum?#$r 28 0 Sun_28#Gusto ko ang buhok mo gaya niyan!

records.source: $p 27#I was going to dye my hair but then I decided against it.|Yes? What is it?
records.translation: $p 27#Kukulayan ko sana ang buhok ko pero nagpasiya akong huwag na.|Oo? Ano iyon?

records.source: I guess that's a pretty safe choice, huh?#$e#I'll think about it.
records.translation: Siguro ay ligtas na pagpili iyan, ha?#$e#Pag-iisipan ko iyon.

records.source: Of course that's what you'd say.$u
records.translation: Siyempre ay iyan ang sasabihin mo.$u

records.source: You're always good for a laugh.$h
records.translation: Lagi kang mahusay magpatawa.$h

records.source: Are you growing pumpkins on your farm this year?#$e#Save one for me!$h
records.translation: Nagtatanim ka ba ng mga kalabasa sa bukid mo ngayong taon?#$e#Magtira ka ng isa para sa akin!$h

records.source: I may fight with my parents a lot, but I know they're just looking out for me. They're doing what they think is best.$s#$b#I dunno why I'm saying this to you. Don't tell anyone.$8
records.translation: Maaaring madalas akong makipagtalo sa mga magulang ko, pero alam kong pinangangalagaan lang nila ako. Ginagawa nila ang inaakala nilang pinakamabuti.$s#$b#Hindi ko alam kung bakit ko ito sinasabi sa iyo. Huwag mong sabihin kaninuman.$8

records.source: Hi.$h#$e#Your hair looks cool today... did you do something different?
records.translation: Kumusta.$h#$e#Astig ang hitsura ng buhok mo ngayon... may binago ka ba?

records.source: You know, I could actually see myself becoming a farmer some day...#$e#But how would that ever happen? *chuckle*$l
records.translation: Alam mo, naiisip ko talagang maging magsasaka balang araw...#$e#Pero paano mangyayari iyon? *tawa*$l

records.source: I had an interesting dream last night, with you in it.#$e#It was a good dream.$h
records.translation: Nagkaroon ako ng kawili-wiling panaginip kagabi, at naroon ka.#$e#Magandang panaginip iyon.$h

records.source: I wish the season lasted a little longer.$8#$e#When the wind really picks up, I almost feel like a kid again.
records.translation: Sana ay tumagal pa nang kaunti ang panahong ito.$8#$e#Kapag talagang lumalakas ang hangin, para akong bata ulit.

records.source: I usually feel lonely this time of year, but not anymore.$l#$e#@, what are your plans for the future?
records.translation: Karaniwan ay nalulungkot ako sa ganitong panahon ng taon, pero hindi na ngayon.$l#$e#@, ano ang mga plano mo para sa hinaharap?

records.source: Well, fall is over...$s#$e#But I like winter, too!$h
records.translation: Aba, tapos na ang taglagas...$s#$e#Pero gusto ko rin ang taglamig!$h

records.source: It's just too cold to go outside much.#$e#But I do enjoy building a snowgoon.$h
records.translation: Masyado lang talagang malamig upang madalas lumabas.#$e#Pero nasisiyahan akong gumawa ng salbaheng taong-niyebe.$h

records.source: Doesn't a steaming hot cup of cocoa sound good right now?
records.translation: Hindi ba masarap ngayon ang isang mainit at umuusok na tasa ng kakaw?

records.source: Hi. Is it boring to be a farmer during the winter?
records.translation: Kumusta. Nakababagot bang maging magsasaka tuwing taglamig?

records.source: I'm definitely going to enter the egg hunt tomorrow. Are you?
records.translation: Talagang sasali ako sa paghahanap ng itlog bukas. Ikaw?

records.source: Well, tomorrow is the flower dance. Dancing is alright, but they make me wear this stupid white dress...$s
records.translation: Aba, bukas ang Sayaw ng mga Bulaklak. Ayos lang ang pagsasayaw, pero pinapasuot nila sa akin ang walang kuwentang puting bestidang ito...$s

records.source: I'm looking forward to making a snow man tomorrow.
records.translation: Inaasam kong gumawa ng taong-niyebe bukas.

records.source: Will I see you tomorrow at the Spirit's Eve festival? Look for me in the haunted maze.$h
records.translation: Makikita ba kita bukas sa Bisperas ng mga Espiritu? Hanapin mo ako sa labirintong pinagmumultuhan.$h

records.source: Everyone's excited for the Luau tomorrow. Maybe a little nervous, too, considering the Governor will be here.
records.translation: Nasasabik ang lahat sa Luau bukas. Baka medyo kinakabahan din dahil pupunta rito ang Gobernador.

records.source: You can't miss tomorrow's festival. It's one of the most beautiful wonders of the valley.
records.translation: Huwag mong palampasin ang pista bukas. Isa iyon sa pinakamagagandang kababalaghan ng lambak.

records.source: I'm going to eat so much cranberry sauce tomorrow.$h
records.translation: Kakain ako ng napakaraming sarsang cranberry bukas.$h

records.source: Another year is almost over.#$e#It goes by so fast, doesn't it?$s
records.translation: Malapit nang matapos ang isa na namang taon.#$e#Napakabilis nitong lumipas, hindi ba?$s

records.source: One thing I've learned living here... everyone stares at you if you look different.
records.translation: Isang bagay ang natutuhan ko sa paninirahan dito... tinititigan ka ng lahat kung naiiba ang hitsura mo.

records.source: It's the weekend!#$e#That means I can play twice as many video games.$h#$e#Bye.
records.translation: Katapusan ng linggo na!#$e#Ibig sabihin ay makapaglalaro ako ng dobleng dami ng mga video game.$h#$e#Paalam.

records.source: Oh, hello.#$q 29/30 winter_Sun_old#I made these two drawings. What do you think?#$r 29 20 Sun_29#I like the jungle island and the tiger.#$r 30 5 Sun_30#I like the orc with the battleaxe.#$r 29 -50 Sun_Bad#I don't like either of them.
records.translation: Ah, kumusta.#$q 29/30 winter_Sun_old#Ginawa ko ang dalawang guhit na ito. Ano sa tingin mo?#$r 29 20 Sun_29#Gusto ko ang isla sa gubat at ang tigre.#$r 30 5 Sun_30#Gusto ko ang orko na may palakol-pandigma.#$r 29 -50 Sun_Bad#Wala akong gusto sa dalawa.

records.source: $p 29#Remember those drawings I showed you a while ago? I accidentally threw them away.$s|Remember that drawing I showed you with the orc? I entered it into an online contest and won 50g!$h
records.translation: $p 29#Naaalala mo ang mga guhit na ipinakita ko sa iyo noong nakaraan? Hindi ko sinasadyang maitapon ang mga iyon.$s|Naaalala mo ang guhit na ipinakita ko sa iyo na may orko? Isinali ko iyon sa isang paligsahan sa internet at nanalo ako ng 50g!$h

records.source: Oh yeah? I guess that makes sense.
records.translation: Ah, talaga? Siguro ay may katuturan iyon.

records.source: I'm glad. It's embarrassing to share your art with others. But I think you and I are on the same page.
records.translation: Natutuwa ako. Nakakahiya ang ibahagi sa iba ang sining mo. Pero sa tingin ko'y magkaunawaan tayo.

records.source: Rude! Why would you hurt my feelings like that? You're so insensitive!$s
records.translation: Bastos! Bakit mo sasaktan nang ganoon ang damdamin ko? Napakamanhid mo!$s

records.source: Hi. If you're ever bored, you can always hang out in my room.#$e#As long as I'm not changing, of course!
records.translation: Kumusta. Kung nababagot ka, maaari kang tumambay sa kuwarto ko.#$e#Basta hindi ako nagpapalit ng damit, siyempre!

records.source: It's so cold, I wish we had a hot cup of cocoa to share.$h
records.translation: Napakalamig, sana ay may mainit tayong tasa ng kakaw na pagsasaluhan.$h

records.source: I've been daydreaming a lot lately...#$e#Oh! You want to know what it's about? Well...$u#$b#...It's a secret.$h
records.translation: Madalas akong nananaginip nang gising nitong huli...#$e#Ah! Gusto mong malaman kung tungkol saan? Aba...$u#$b#...Lihim iyon.$h

records.source: Another year is almost over...#$b#But this was a really good year, don't you think?$h
records.translation: Malapit nang matapos ang isa na namang taon...#$b#Pero napakaganda ng taong ito, hindi ba?$h

records.source: It must be nice not having crops to worry about this time of year.#$e#And that means you can hang out with me more often!$h
records.translation: Siguradong masarap na walang mga pananim na aalalahanin sa ganitong panahon ng taon.#$e#At ibig sabihin niyan ay mas madalas kang makatatambay kasama ko!$h

records.source: @, there's something I want to tell you...#$e#It's just... um... well... your boots! They, uh...look really clean... *gulp*#$e#That's all... *sigh*$s
records.translation: @, may gusto akong sabihin sa iyo...#$e#Ito lang... um... aba... ang mga bota mo! Uh...malinis na malinis ang mga iyon... *lagok*#$e#Iyon lang... *buntong-hininga*$s

records.source: I can't trust a person who doesn't like animals...#$e#Oh, don't worry! I know you're an animal lover!$h
records.translation: Hindi ko mapagkakatiwalaan ang isang taong ayaw sa mga hayop...#$e#Ah, huwag mag-alala! Alam kong mahilig ka sa mga hayop!$h
